spec.claim_summary: Long BTC on 4-hour Supertrend flip from downtrend to uptrend with ATR-based stop, 0.75R partial profit with breakeven move and exit of remainder on opposite Supertrend flip.
assumptions: BTCUSD interpreted as BTCUSDT spot for testing.
Timeframe is 4H as stated in the claim.
Supertrend settings not stated; using defaults ATR length 10 and multiplier 3 for entry and exit.
ATR stop-loss multiplier and ATR length not stated; using 2.0 x ATR(14) at the signal bar.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: partial exit closing half the position at 0.75 risk/reward and holding the remainder to the opposite Supertrend flip; schema holds the full position to the opposite flip with no intermediate target.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: moving the stop loss to breakeven after the 0.75R first target is hit; schema keeps the original ATR stop for the entire trade.
Entry and exit signals evaluated on bar closes per test harness.

evidence.quote: you enter into a long position.
Once Supertrend changes from a downtrend to a uptrend, you enter into a long position.
Once Supertrend changes from a uptrend to a downtrend, you close the other half of the initial long position.
The stop loss will be defined by the atr stop loss

audit_majors: take_profit_r: Claim requires closing half the position at 0.75 risk/reward; spec sets take_profit_r null and holds the full position to the opposite Supertrend flip with no intermediate target.
stop_atr_mult: Claim requires moving the stop loss to breakeven after the 0.75R target is hit; spec keeps the original ATR stop for the entire trade.
